override.reason: The triplication is the install/customize/reconcile contract, not an accident of this change: the overlay exists so a project can customize a template, and the .baseline/ mirror exists so drift between project copy and upstream is detectable. Collapsing the copies would delete that capability. The sweep did the required thing -- I verified all three copies are byte-identical for all five templates by sha256. The one genuine residual is that a FOURTH recorded copy (TEMPLATES_MANIFEST.json's sha256 per template) was not updated; that is raised as a review finding and a triage candidate rather than swallowed by this override.
